title: The Feature Flag That Ignores Opt-Outs
description: Customers who explicitly opted out still receive a new feature, while allowlisted customers are blocked by rollout percentages.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: enabled(user,bucket,percent,allow,deny) validates percent in 0..100 and bucket in 0..99. Deny overrides allow; allow overrides percentage. Other users are enabled exactly when bucket < percent. Inputs are immutable. C++ uses vector<string> allow/deny and integer bucket/percent.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
